source: Williamson Tea Kenya Plc audited consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year ended 31 March 2026, from the signed annual report and financial statements, audited by PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP. Figures printed in Shs thousands and stored in KES. Revenue 3,400,132, cost of sales 3,056,349, gross profit 460,570, other income 108,951, distribution costs 198,804, administrative expenses 295,527, operating profit 75,190, interest income 38,350, finance income 32,243, share of profit of associate 77,911, profit before tax 223,694, income tax 102,742, profit from continuing operations 120,952, loss from discontinued operations 153, profit for the year 120,799 of which owners 116,043, basic and diluted earnings per share 3.31. Gross profit is operating income (revenue plus the 116,787 net fair value gain on biological assets) less cost of sales, the presentation the issuer uses and the one already applied to the earlier years in this file. Operating expenses is distribution costs plus administrative expenses. Operating profit plus net finance income plus the associate share gives profit before tax (75,190 plus 70,593 plus 77,911 equals 223,694). Profit before tax less tax gives 120,952 of continuing profit, and the 153 loss from discontinued operations takes it to the 120,799 profit for the year that is stored.

reconciliation_note: Net Profit (computed) matches the source's period total on every period. Operating Profit (EBIT) less Net Finance Costs plus Other Income equals Profit Before Tax does not hold in FY2025, FY2024, FY2023: the statement bridges operating profit to profit before tax through further lines (Interest Income; Net Interest Income Total; Gains/(Losses) From Changes In Fair Value Of Biological Assets - Fuel Trees; Gains/(Losses) From Changes In Fair Value Of Biological Assets - Timber Trees; Gains/(Losses) From Changes In Fair Value Of Biological Assets - Unharvested Green Leaf) and the file's own bridge reproduces the filed profit before tax; both figures are shown unchanged. Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit does not hold in FY2025 because the statement carries items below profit before tax (Loss From Discontinued Operations); the figures are as filed.
